input.question: What is the population of Marlette?

documents.text: Marlette Township, Michigan Marlette Township is a civil township of Sanilac County in the U.S. state of Michigan. The population was 2,051 at the 2000 census. According to the United States Census Bureau, the township has a total area of , all land. As of the census of 2000, there were 2,051 people, 697 households, and 579 families residing in the township. The population density was 39.1 per square mile (15.1/km²). There were 743 housing units at an average density of 14.2 per square mile (5.5/km²). The racial makeup of the township was 97.90% White, 0.15% African American, 0.20% Native
